content.text: Core network protocols that power the internet — from transport-layer reliability to application-layer communication and security.

items: TCP/IP — Transport and internet layer protocols, connection management, and flow control
DNS — Domain name resolution, record types, caching, and DNS security
HTTP — HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, methods, headers, and caching
TLS & mTLS — Transport layer security, certificate management, and mutual authentication
